name: Montana Cybersecurity Summer Initiative (CSI) Camp
what_you_do: A day camp for Montana students. It lasts a week. You learn about cybersecurity.
who_can_apply: Montana middle school and high school students (grades 6 to 12 in fall 2026 for the 2026 camp).
deadline_text: 2026 camp was June 15 to 19. 2027 dates are not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Use the "Learn more & register for CSI camp" link on the MSU Continuing Education youth page.
notes: Held at the Gallatin College East Campus IT Cybersecurity Lab in Bozeman. Camp has no cost.
